full_name: Chang-Ling Huang | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Social Sciences Radcliffe-Harvard Yenching Institute Fellow National Taiwan University (Taiwan)
bio: Chang-Ling Huang is a professor of political science at National Taiwan University. Her research interests are quota politics and state feminism.
